title: Trace-to-Architecture: Capability Bottleneck Diagnosis for Harness Revision
abstract: arXiv:2610.16725v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Improving an LLM agent requires knowing what to change when it fails. Similar failures can require different fixes, and resolving one problem can expose another. We introduce Trace-to-Architecture (T2A), a framework that uses execution trajectories to determine what to change in an agent's harness and when those changes apply. A development agent diagnoses failures using execution evidence from successful and failed tasks, revises the corresponding harness components, and then checks whether target tasks improve, selected successful tasks remain successful, and the edits are actually triggered. New execution evidence guides subsequent diagnosis and revision. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and AppWorld, T2A achieves the highest aggregate score for all three evaluated task agents, exceeding their respective strongest baselines by 6.2--30.3 points. tldr: 该论文提出Trace-to-Architecture（T2A）框架，通过分析执行轨迹来诊断LLM智能体框架中的能力瓶颈，并迭代修订框架组件和验证修改效果，在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和AppWorld三个基准上以6.2至30.3分的优势超越最强基线。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Trace-to-Architecture (T2A), a framework that uses execution trajectories to diagnose capability bottlenecks in an LLM agent's harness and iteratively revise and validate its components, achieving the highest aggregate scores on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and AppWorld and exceeding the strongest baselines by 6.2–30.3 points.
